summary: Wide Carmody Road kerb backing onto bush, homes over 20m away across road.
reasons: Bush behind, no homes on this side

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the south side; nearest dwelling 23m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide road with painted edge; cars park beside the lane here in 2022 imagery.
drivers.traffic: Through road, moderate traffic, but van stands out of the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars parked on both kerbs in QLD image; none visible in the newer Esri image.

flags: Slope about 3%, at the steep threshold
Carmody Road is a through route with noise
sun_shade: Bush canopy overhangs the kerb from the south; shade much of the day, morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: South kerb of Carmody Road below the bush bank, east of the bus bay bend
